reason: Per-ticker enumeration would require scanning the large SQLite database, OHLCV history and thousands of BCTC files. Phase 3 uses safe discovery-level coverage instead.
coverage_caveats: News has no ticker field, so has_news cannot be reliably populated without entity linking.
Missing shareholder rows must be interpreted with shareholders_progress.
Price presence does not imply current tradability.
Financial and metadata coverage counts were not freshly scanned.
limitations: No individual ticker records are included.
Counts are observed/approximate as of discovery.
